evidence.quote: So, as you might imagine, the recent decline in availability of credit to small businesses concerns me.
The more we do now, the better prepared our small businesses and lending institutions will be when economic growth and consumer demand pick up.
But we can and should be sure that supervisory policies do not impede the flow of credit to all eligible borrowers.

parsed.rationale: The speech is about small business credit access, supervisory guidance and data collection, not monetary policy. It notes difficult economic conditions and tight credit, a mild dovish tone on activity, but takes no policy view.
